name: adminwright
description: Design, build, extend, or audit a complete admin console for any platform, in any stack — backed by a machine-checkable manifest that refuses to call the work done until every screen traces to a real server operation, policy, data source, audit event, test, and evidence file. Ships six role agents (architect, implementer, ux-reviewer, qa, security, harvester) that coordinate through the manifest, install into any harness, and learn from every run.
